conditions.runtime: Authenticated production race player or authorized integrated sandbox owner; protection only while first authoritative selection is pending or its existing bounded exit scene completes.

change.summary: Prevent permanent combat immunity via race menu and selection packet replay.

modifiers.before: Any authenticated player may create a600-tick protected scene using action6; clearing and reopening permits unlimited renewal.
modifiers.after: New scenes require authoritative unselected race state; selected progression-menu reopen cannot create immunity. Existing first-choice scene remains protected until selection and completion.

modifiers.before: Every selection acknowledgement sets scene expiry to current tick+100, allowing repeated same-race selections to extend existing immunity.
modifiers.after: A transient server-owned completing marker permits exactly one100-tick completion window; repeated acknowledgements cannot extend it, including when initial selection took longer than600ticks.

rationale.purpose: Keep initial selection safe while preventing indefinite invulnerability from repeatable UI input.
rationale.decision_source: User2026-10-20 Power System Revamp explicitly prohibits permanent invulnerability and requires preserved keybinds/saves/abilities.
rationale.user_requested: Source-proven combat exploits corrected with server authority.
rationale.codex_choices: Reject only new scene creation after selection and mark first completion exactly once; no packet format, ability, selection/switch rule, save schema or cooldown redesign.

introduced.summary: Reject new protection scenes after authoritative race selection and complete each existing scene at most once; preserve mandatory first-choice protection and100-tick exit even after a long initial choice.
